name: Two Places at Once
description:
Aurora Health's incident-response team knows what DEADFACE did. They still don't know how they got in - until DEADFACE bragged about it. This post surfaced on the GhostTown forum. One legitimate account, used from two places at once. Find the compromised account - the one whose login shows up on two different workstations at the very same timestamp, over and over. Report that account's username.

Use the provided MySQL shell.

Submit the username as deadface{username}. Example: deadface{jsmith}.

[	Access Database](https://aurora.dctf.io/)
